name: Doraemon Bridge (Edit)
description: Watches for Doraemon request edits and processes them through Kiro chat

then.prompt:
A Doraemon request has been updated. Read the file .doraemon/request.json to see what Doraemon wants. Process the request based on its type:

- If type is 'chat': Answer the message field as a normal chat request
- If type is 'command': Execute the command field
- If type is 'file-edit': Edit the specified file with the content

After processing, write the response to .doraemon/response.json with this format:
{
  "id": "<same id from request>",
  "success": true/false,
  "result": "<your response or result>",
  "error": "<error message if failed>",
  "timestamp": <current timestamp>
}

Then delete the request.json file.
